### Sitemap.xml
**File:** `/app/sitemap.ts`

**Status:** ✅ **FULLY CONFIGURED** (Lines 1-55)

```typescript
export default function sitemap(): MetadataRoute.Sitemap {
  const baseUrl = 'https://josephibrahim.com';
  
  // Static pages
  const staticPages: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = [
    { url: baseUrl, priority: 1, changeFrequency: 'weekly' },
    { url: `${baseUrl}/info`, priority: 0.8, changeFrequency: 'monthly' },
    { url: `${baseUrl}/photo`, priority: 0.7, changeFrequency: 'monthly' },
    { url: `${baseUrl}/process`, priority: 0.8, changeFrequency: 'weekly' },
  ];
  
  // Project pages (dynamic)
  const projectPages: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = projects.map((project) => ({
    url: `${baseUrl}/projects/${project.slug}`,
    lastModified: new Date(),
    changeFrequency: 'monthly' as const,
    priority: 0.9,
  }));
  
  // Process posts (dynamic)
  const processPages: MetadataRoute.Sitemap = allProcessPosts.map((post) => ({
    url: `${baseUrl}/process/${post.slug}`,
    lastModified: new Date(),
    changeFrequency: 'monthly' as const,
    priority: 0.7,
  }));
  
  return [...staticPages, ...projectPages, ...processPages];
}
```

**Coverage:**
- ✅ All static pages indexed
- ✅ All project pages included (generated from `projects` array)
- ✅ All process posts included (generated from `processPosts` array)
- ✅ Last modified dates and change frequencies set
- ✅ Priority weights reflect page importance
